kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستحصد (form X)
# نَسْتَحْصِدُ (nastaḥṣidu) /nas.taħ.sˤi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْصَدَ (istaḥṣada)
# نَسْتَحْصِدَ (nastaḥṣida) /nas.taħ.sˤi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحْصَدَ (istaḥṣada)
# نَسْتَحْصِدْ (nastaḥṣid) /nas.taħ.sˤid/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَحْصَدَ (istaḥṣada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
